7cba81e3110af5750665d7f7dbf58edd943a1808.summary: Promotional page for a Kaspersky GReAT webinar, published 2022-03-10, on recent cyberattacks targeting Ukraine. It lists the presenters and says the talk will cover attack types, destructive malware analysis and defence advice, followed by Q&A. It contains no findings of its own and reads as a marketing piece for a webinar channel, so it is not a threat report.

7ca859e1c3ff30accae6389d950538677012b677.summary: RFC 1918, a 1996 IETF Best Current Practice, sets aside private IPv4 address ranges for internal networks that do not need direct internet connectivity. It covers allocation rules, route filtering, DNS separation and renumbering trade-offs. It is a networking standard, not a threat report: it describes no actors, campaigns, malware, vulnerabilities or incidents, and it states that security issues are not addressed.
